Enter the local administrator password so Lyra Agent can run local operations that require sudo in managed or full auto mode. It is stored encrypted and loaded into the local Agent runtime; the model cannot read the plaintext, but the host supplies it to sudo when the Agent runs a protected command.
Persistent administrator credential for Lyra Agent managed and full auto modes.

Full auto mode uses the same tool policy as managed mode, then after 10 seconds of idle on any turn-blocking panel Lyra thinks and answers that panel for you. It will not click OS password or UAC dialogs. This is the red tier. Continue only when you accept unattended decisions on those panels.
You have a saved administrator credential. Delete it when switching back to approval mode, or keep it for future use.

Managed mode lets Lyra Agent skip per-action tool approvals in this local session and run the operations it decides are needed. Questions, plan review, and other turn-blocking panels still wait for you. Lyra can read and write project files, run commands, operate browser pages, use authorized accounts, and may coordinate system capabilities, project code, and external devices. That is part of its power, and it also makes misuse genuinely risky. If you do not understand this mode, do not enable it. Continue only when you trust the current task, workspace, and model output.
